title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Pineapple Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Pineapple Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit brings a tropical fruit burst with a frosty exhale. The Pineapple delivers an intense, juicy sweetness with a slightly tangy edge, while the Ice adds a clean, cooling finish that lifts the flavour and keeps it feeling crisp throughout. It’s a bright, refreshing vape that’s perfect for fans of fruit with a cool twist. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is designed for exclusive use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The magnetic connection and twist-to-switch mouthpiece make flavour swaps simple and mess-free. With two pods in each pack, Pineapple Ice makes a lively addition to your pod rotation—especially when paired with other tropical, citrus, or menthol blends.
